|birth = {{ne|951}}}}'''Erian Boroleos''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].

== Appearance and Personality ==
Erian  is pale and lovely. She has dark hair and brown eyes, and is beautiful.{{ref/book|6|25}} She is short and slender, and her pale face is like an exquisite oval.{{ref/book|6|53}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Erian is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|23}}. She is strong enough to be able to [[Traveling|Travel]].

==History==
Erian is from [[Illian]] and is 49 years old. She was born in {{ne|951}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|966}}. After spending seven years as a [[novice]] and five years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the [[shawl]] in [[978 NE]]. She had four [[Warders]], but two of them were killed by [[Rand al'Thor]]. The other two are named [[Rashan]] and [[Bartol]].{{ref/book|6|53}} [[Galina Casban]], the [[Highest]] of the [[Red Ajah]], became infatuated with Erian.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Galina Casban}}

==Activities==
=== Rand's capture ===
She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split. 
She is part of the White Tower embassy that makes an alliance with the [[Shaido]].{{ref/book|6|p}}

Erian and the rest of the embassy ride into [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|6|24}}
Erian, [[Coiren Saeldain]], [[Galina Casban]], and [[Sarene Nemdahl]] discuss Rand.{{ref/book|6|25}}

Erian tries to find out what the [[Atha'an Miere]] are doing in Cairhien. She is refused permission to board their ships.{{ref/book|6|27}}

She was one of the Aes Sedai who kidnapped and beat Rand. During an escape attempt, Rand killed two of her Warders.{{ref/book|6|53}} Galina gives Erian permission to beat Rand, but Erian refuses to beat him after the second day.{{ref/book|6|55}}

=== Swearing fealty ===

She was captured by the [[Asha'man]] at the Battle of [[Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|6|55}}

[[Sorilea]] brings [[Elza Penfell]], [[Nesune Bihara]], Sarene, [[Beldeine Nyram]], and Erian to Rand after they beg to be allowed to swear fealty to him. Rand accepts.{{ref/book|8|29}}

Erian and Beldeine play stones while [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] and [[Harine din Togara Two Winds|Harine din Togara]] speak in the sunroom of the [[Sun Palace]].{{ref/book|9|13}} Beldeine, Elza, Erian, Nesune and Sarene are in also in the sun room with Cadsuane when Sorilea enters and gives them a lecture.{{ref/book|9|13}}

Erian was one of the Aes Sedai who accompanied Cadsuane to [[Far Madding]], but must leave her Warders behind.{{ref/book|9|23}}

Although Erian isn't mentioned during the [[cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']],{{ref/book|9|35}} Jordan said that this was a mistake and that she actually was meant to be guarding the non-channelers in the group (Min, Harine etc.) along Lan and the other Warders. This is confirmed by "The Wheel of Time Companion".

When Rand stays at [[House Pendaloan]] manor in [[Tear]] to recover after cleansing ''[[saidin]]'', Erian and the rest of the group go with him. She pushes past Elza to inform Rand that her Warders are [[Traveling]] towards her.{{ref/book|9|23}}

She helps Sarene and Nesune maintain [[Semirhage]]'s [[shield]] while [[Merise Haindehl]] interrogates the captive. This is more than traditionally necessary according to Cadsuane.{{ref/book|12|5}}

Elza, Erian, and [[Daigian Moseneillin]] watch Cadsuane spank Semirhage. They were holding the shield for Sarene.{{ref/book|12|19}}

She goes to Rand's room after finding out about Semirhage's escape and then death. After this episode Erian, Nesune, Sarene, and Beldeine are less welcome in Rand's presence.{{ref/book|12|48}}

As is the case with all the sisters sworn to Rand, it can be presumed that Erian fought in [[Thakan'dar Valley]] during the [[Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|34}} It is not stated whether she survived the battle or not.

== Viewings ==
One of [[Min's viewings]] shows an aura of blue, yellow and green around Erian. It means she will serve Rand in her own fashion.{{ref/book|8|29}}
